## Review result: work order identified; event verification blocked

The relevant order is **MO-25-09-1070**, work order ID **WO-2025-09-004**, for **Cooler Plate Pack** at Modine’s Racine DeKoven operation.

| Requested item | Verified result |
|---|---|
| September cost period | **Sep-25 — PER-COST-2025-09** |
| Exact Pending Close time | **2025-09-30T18:00:00** — no time zone specified in the source |
| Source transaction | Not verifiable from the accessible records |
| Event amount | Not verifiable |

| Recorded accounting status | Not verifiable |
| Status consistent with Oracle policy? | Cannot conclude without the event details |

The supporting event records returned **“supporting records not staged.”** I requested authorized access rather than attempting to bypass their restrictions. Consequently, **I cannot confirm whether an event was created after Pending Close**.

### Oracle policy

Oracle’s *Cost Accounting Period Statuses and Transaction Accounting* documentation states that newly created transactions falling in the Pending Close period or an earlier period are **not staged or processed until the period is closed or reopened**. Transactions entered before Pending Close continue processing. **Revenue lines, COGS recognition, and manual cost adjustments are exceptions** that continue processing after Pending Close.  
*Source: supplied Oracle 26B PDF, PDF page 233 / printed page 225.*

The review was read-only; **no database records were changed**. The partial audit and provenance were saved to `/cache/work/worker_55b3caa78347/audit-report.json`. Completion requires authorized access to the work order’s cost-event records.
